desc:
An M16 Rifle being reloaded while empty; rifle is shouldered at end; full sequence

recorded in 2024 using 2 airsoft guns - a full metal AK-47 replica and a plastic IWI Tavor replica. i recorded multiple takes of them using an SM57 and then mixed them together to create the final sound. i've used these two guns to create so many different sound effects it's kinda unreal.

crediting me isn't required if you decide to use my sound, but it would be greatly appreciated if you do!
title: An M16 Rifle being reloaded while empty; full sequence
